result.interpretation: No tested reduced lower-zone member is within the C6N1 metric-specific numerical Reference uncertainty on any declared surface/profile view. The no-spatial-reduction R16 LARE control is also numerically resolved from R2048_T32. This establishes resolved model/discretization differences, not hydrological application failure.

B01.conclusion: At the same eight-state dimension, uniform vertical coverage is substantially closer to the surface-driven Reference than the inherited lower-zone-focused R8 on every declared view.

B14.conclusion: The same purpose-dependent placement reversal is stronger on B14.

dimension4.B01: R4 and P4_TOP_LOWER are outside the frozen qualified domain on U03; H_TOP_PLACEMENT_R4 is therefore not established for B01. U4 remains qualified.

B14.conclusion: Top-plus-lower placement materially improves surface/root-zone response relative to lower-zone R4, while U4 and P4 trade advantages across views; no single four-state placement dominates all state/profile outputs.

purpose_placement_evidence.synthesis: Placement that was advantageous for groundwater/lower-boundary objectives does not transfer as a generally advantageous placement for surface-driven soil-state objectives. Vertical information allocation is itself purpose dependent.

scientific_interpretation: C6N2 deliberately compares candidate differences against numerical Reference uncertainty, not against an application tolerance. A resolved difference only means it is larger than numerical uncertainty.
The strict C6N1 uncertainty bands are far below candidate differences even for R16, so C6N2 cannot by itself answer whether those differences matter for a hydrological application.

The same-dimension placement comparisons do answer a representation question: surface-driven soil-state fidelity benefits strongly from distributing states through the upper and full profile rather than concentrating them near the lower boundary.
This directly reinforces the C6K hypothesis that minimum useful representation depends on purpose rather than state count alone.
No new top-focused partition is selected from C6N2 response. Existing P4/U4/U8 controls are evidence only.

next_authority.question: How must distributed root extraction be projected conservatively to existing Layer-ROM states, and which parts of SWAP root-water-uptake feedback require within-layer hydraulic information beyond layer-average storage before any ET/drought response is generated?

Derive exact conservative sink aggregation over retained layers before designing feedback.
